sources.note: No descriptive references at all (Glottolog lists no grammar, sketch or phonology); page records retirement via CR 2014-033 effective 2015-01-12, reason 'non-existent', alternative name Ibuya.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.1, languoid buyu1239 'Buyu' [byi] (alt. names Bujwe, Buyi, Kibuyu; DRC; vigorous)
sources.note: Checked only for identity: this is the code the RA presumes Buya duplicates. Page lists no grammar/phonology; only a 2021 Ricquier et al. subclassification comment is visible. Our own our earlier survey has buyu1239 as no source found.

sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority / Editor Ethnologue (SIL International). 2014. Request for Change to ISO 639-3 Language Code, Change Request Number 2014-033: retire Buya [byy] (adopted 2015-01-12). 5 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing about stress or any linguistic feature; the form retires the code because 'There is no evidence that the language exists': Buya [byy] is 'an unclassifed Southern Bantoid language of the DRC without a location' traceable only to Welmers (1971:788-789) and 'in all likelihood.. a rendering of a DRC language already counted in another E16 entry, presumbly Buyu [byi]' (p. 2, sec. 3(c)). Sole source cited: Welmers 1971 checklist.

sources.citation: Wikipedia, 'Buyu language' (section on ISO coding problems; cites Ethnologue 17/18 and Maho 2009 NUGL)
sources.note: Nothing on stress; states 'Buya' [byy] is unidentified and 'may be a typo for Buyu' [byi]; byy, bmy (Bemba of South Kivu) and sgo (Songa) all retired 2014 as names for Buyu-speaking groups.

sources.citation: Welmers, William E. 1971. Checklist of African language and dialect names. In Thomas A. Sebeok (ed.), Linguistics in Sub-Saharan Africa (Current Trends in Linguistics 7), 761-899 (entry at pp. 788-789). The Hague: Mouton.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.access_detail: publisher DOI, paywalled; library e-access not checked
sources.note: The sole source for the name 'Buya'; reading its one-line entry would confirm what variety the name was meant to cover (the RA guesses Buyu [byi]). It is a name list and will contain no stress statement.
